SHARED-F-2-S56.title: Consent Data Schema and Persistence Contract
SHARED-F-2-S56.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema and persistence contract for consent records, including tier state, timestamps, audit metadata, and linkage to session/conversation IDs.

SHARED-F-2-S57.title: Consent Service API Endpoints
SHARED-F-2-S57.description: Expose backend API endpoints for capturing, updating, and retrieving consent tier status, ensuring compatibility with tool_router and FastAPI entrypoints.

SHARED-F-2-S58.title: Integration with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flows
SHARED-F-2-S58.description: Integrate consent framework with lead_capture and unknown_question services to enforce Tier 2 consent requirements before storing identifiable user data.

SHARED-F-2-S59.title: Audit Logging and Compliance Traceability
SHARED-F-2-S59.description: Implement audit logging for all consent actions (capture, upgrade, downgrade, enforcement decisions) with traceability for compliance review and debugging.
